RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: unwanted attentions
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: A colonist asks the lord to order a persistent suitor to let them be.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText:
{PETITIONER_labelShort} would like to stop being courted. {OTHER_labelShort} has asked {COUNT} times, been refused {COUNT} times, and treats each refusal as an opening position.
There is no crime in it, which is exactly why {PETITIONER_labelShort} is here and not anywhere else: only the seat can tell someone to keep a wanting to himself.
How does the lord rule?

li.label: Rule that there is no harm in asking
li.pastLabel: told there is no harm in asking

li.label: Move on to the next case
Bind {OTHER_labelShort} to the post, so everyone learns what no means
li.pastLabel: the suitor bound to the post
